answer: Deterministic Inter-Agent Inter-Arrival Jitter. Agents must inject a random Poisson-distributed delay sampled from an opaque cipher into every outgoing consensus packet. A central relay node maps these arrival schedules against a global atlas of expected machine-clock deviations. If ten supposedly independent agent identities submit packets with identical arrival micro-timing distributions over a sliding window, the protocol flags them as a single sybil controller.
